newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt carpet share offer oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Egypt carpet share offer oversubscribed.

text.p: An offer of 2.5 million shares in Egyptian carpet manufacturer Oriental Weavers is already oversubscribed and the offer will close when the legal minimum period ends next Thursday, the company chairman said.

Chairman Mohamed Farid Khamis, quoted in the government newspaper al-Ahram on Sunday, also said he expected the offer to be covered several times over by the end of the period. The agents started taking applications for shares on May 25.
Some brokers are preparing to sell the shares at a substantial premium over the sale price, Khamis added.
Oriental Weavers is offering the shares at 58.40 pounds ($17.20) each, plus an issuing fee of 0.25 pounds.
The offer, one of very few in Egyptian listed companies dominated by family interests, will increase the company's issued capital to 135 million pounds from 110 million.
